revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Shared-heap prerequisite: synchronous authority allocation/read/write/CAS calls retain no guest continuation or callback. Node client belongs to the existing system namespace and shutdown set; browser page serializes the same allocator. No EIP/ESP ownership or callback entry/restoration changes; broader ownership remains pending.
